name: Frontend-Killer
description: Frontend-Killer is a web-based game list manager for emulator frontends. Import, manage, export and scrape game metadata and media across Pegasus, ES-DE, RetroBat, EmuELEC, Lakka and more, with full ScreenScraper integration (auto metadata/media download, CRC32 matching, quota monitoring).

paths.name: App Data (db / rules / media / logs)
paths.description: Persistent storage: H2 database, import/export rules, scraped media, input, output, backups and logs. Map to an appdata share so data survives container updates.

paths.name: ROM Library
paths.description: Your ROM library, used as the import source and for CRC/file-existence checks. Point this at the share holding your game files. Optional but recommended.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Web interface port. Container listens on 8080.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Process User ID. Files written to the mapped paths will be owned by this UID (unRAID nobody = 99). Set to 0 to run as root.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Process Group ID. Files written to the mapped paths will be owned by this GID (unRAID users = 100).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai, Europe/London, America/New_York.

variables.name: JVM Options
variables.description: JVM options. Increase -Xmx for very large libraries.

variables.name: Tomcat Base Dir
variables.description: Tomcat working directory, kept on the persistent volume.

variables.name: Static Resource Locations
variables.description: Extra static resource locations so media under /data can be served over HTTP.
